metrics.profile_summary: Accomplished Executive with over 13 years of experience in operational management and business leadership. Expert in business administration, change management, and staff supervision with a focus on profitability and operational efficiency.

experience.description: Develops customer service standards, monitors policy compliance, evaluates satisfaction levels, and trains staff on POS systems and SOPs.
Supported daily organizational operations, developed employee work rules, and collaborated with top management on operational issues.
Managed visa issues, clearing and forwarding, payroll assistance, and worker accommodation and food logistics.
Handled inbound customer calls, resolved queries effectively, and evaluated calls to enhance quality levels.

weaknesses: Lack of technical skills in GA4 and ad platform reporting
No experience with brand strategy, CAC/LTV, or integrated campaigns
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a seasoned operations and customer service manager but lacks all the core marketing competencies and technical requirements specified in the job description.
